name: leetlens
description: A LeetCode practice client for learning algorithms. AI turns questions, chats, and submissions into a knowledge map and a review queue.
author: huaxx-lab

scripts.package:mac: node scripts/prepare-renderer-assets.js && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 && node scripts/prepare-macos-bundle.js && node scripts/sign-macos-bundle.js "dist.noindex/mac-arm64/LeetCode 助手.app" --archive "dist.noindex/LeetCode-AI-Helper-mac-arm64.zip" && node scripts/create-macos-dmg.js "dist.noindex/LeetCode-AI-Helper-mac-arm64.zip" "dist.noindex/LeetCode-AI-Helper-mac-arm64.dmg" && node scripts/prepare-renderer-assets.js --clean
scripts.install:mac: npm run package:mac && node scripts/replace-macos-app.js "dist.noindex/mac-arm64/LeetCode 助手.app" "/Applications/LeetCode 助手.app" && xattr -cr "/Applications/LeetCode 助手.app" && node scripts/sign-macos-bundle.js "/Applications/LeetCode 助手.app" && node scripts/cleanup-macos-package.js && open "/Applications/LeetCode 助手.app"
